title: Do Open Language Models Invent Scripture? BILAL-BENCH: Benchmarking Islamic-Source Fabrication in Bengali
abstract: arXiv:2610.40996v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model invents a Qur'anic verse or hadith, it gives false authority to text that readers may treat as sacred. Existing Islamic hallucination benchmarks are largely Arabic and often closed-ended, while Bengali resources mainly study general-domain hallucination or factual knowledge. We introduce BILAL-BENCH, a 240-question expert-verified benchmark for open-ended Islamic-source fabrication in Bengali. It covers Qur'anic attribution, hadith, fiqh, contemporary issues, and adversarial false-premise prompts, and uses a two-axis rubric that separates source errors from assertiveness. We evaluate seven open-weight models from 1B to 120B on 1,680 double-annotated responses. Six of the seven models confidently fabricate on 79.3-95.3% of source-production questions, with no monotonic improvement from scale. translated_title: 开放语言模型会编造经文吗？BILAL-BENCH：面向孟加拉语伊斯兰文献来源伪造的基准测试
translated_abstract: 当语言模型编造《古兰经》经文或圣训时，它会赋予文本虚假的权威性，而读者可能将这些文本视为神圣的。现有的伊斯兰幻觉基准测试主要以阿拉伯语为主且多为封闭式问题，而孟加拉语资源主要研究一般领域的幻觉或事实性知识。我们提出了BILAL-BENCH，一个包含240个经专家验证问题的基准，用于评测孟加拉语中开放式的伊斯兰文献来源伪造现象。该基准涵盖《古兰经》引用归属、圣训、伊斯兰教法学、当代议题以及对抗性错误前提提示，并采用双轴评分标准，将来源错误与断言强度分开评估。我们在1,680个经过双重标注的响应上评测了七个参数量从1B到120B的开放权重模型。七个模型中有六个在79.3%至95.3%的来源生成问题上自信地编造内容，且性能并未随模型规模扩大而单调提升。圣训溯源是所有模型中最薄弱的类别：315个响应中仅有两个既内容正确又正确标注了来源。
tldr: 该论文提出BILAL-BENCH——首个针对孟加拉语开放式伊斯兰文献来源伪造的专家验证基准，评测发现七个开放权重模型中有六个在79.3%-95.3%的来源生成问题上自信地编造经文内容，且性能不随模型规模提升而改善。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BILAL-BENCH, an expert-verified Bengali benchmark for open-ended Islamic-source fabrication, finding that six of seven open-weight models confidently fabricate on 79.3-95.3% of source-production questions with no monotonic improvement from scale.
